name: FIN: The Way Home
source:
Congratulations! You've just started your first day as a handler-in-training at Oceans of Adventure, the one and only destination to view carcharmorphs: a rare, mysterious species of humanoid fish. Don't let their looks deceive you though, despite their humanlike appearance, they're just an odd looking fish... Right?

[From [url=https://bugbytegaming.itch.io/fin-the-way-home]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜！你刚刚开始在冒险海洋接受训练员的第一天，这是唯一一个可以观赏Carcharmorphs的目的地：一种稀有而神秘的人形鱼类。不过，不要让它们的外表欺骗了你，尽管它们具有人类的外表，但它们只是一种看起来很奇怪的鱼……对吗？

[来自[url=https://bugbytegaming.itch.io/fin-the-way-home]Itch.io[/url]]
